meta.units: bits (pointwise mutual information of upper contour sets)
meta.w: mean over depths 8, 16, 24 bits (depths a pair cannot reach are skipped) of the mean over param-draw pairs; exclusive pairs imputed as min(bound, -depth)
meta.prior: uniform (product-uniform spawn prior of the GridType)
meta.world_settings: none: the atlas is a property of the utility functions under the prior; it does not depend on spawn rate, object count, economy or policies
